In this video we cover:
Zomato Shuts Down Quick | Why 10-Minute Food Delivery Isn’t Working
Zomato has shut down its 10-minute delivery service due to low restaurant density and poor customer experience. It’ll now focus on Blinkit and its new kitchen model, "Bistro by Blinkit." Meanwhile, Swiggy is scaling up Swiggy Bolt to 500+ cities. Why is one exiting and the other doubling down? We explain.
